 DATED : AUGUST 19, 2023  P.C.:
1. Apprehending arrest in connection with C.R. No.108 of 2023 registered with Mumbai Naka Police Station, Nashik for offence punishable under Sections 406, 409, 420, & 120-B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3 and 4 of the Maharashtra Protection of Depositors Interest Act, the applicant is seeking relief of pre-arrest bail under Section 438 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.

entities.text: Maharashtra Protection of Depositors Interest Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. On perusal of the charge-sheet, it appears that the main allegations are against one Avinash Suryavanshi and other two named in the charge-sheet.
No active role is attributed to the applicant in the charge-sheet.

Though the applicant is alleged to be the director of Aadi Shakti Fortune Solutions,
as of today there is no material to show active involvement of the applicant in the 913-aba2294-2023.doc offence alleged.
3.
Learned APP seeks time to investigate into the role of the applicant.
In order to enable the investigating agency to investigate into the role of the applicant in the alleged offence, stand over to 3 October 2023.
However, in the meantime, the applicant deserves to be protected.

f) The applicant shall, at the time of execution of the bond, furnish his address and mobile number to the investigating officer, and the court concerned, and shall not change the residence till the final disposal of the case;
4. List the anticipatory bail application on 3 October 2023.
